allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Once again, Bastian is transported to the world of Fantasia which he recently managed to save from destruction. However, the land is now being destroyed by an evil sorceress, Xayide, so he must join up with Atreyu and face the Emptiness once more.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With Fantasia crumbling under Xayide's dark influence, Bastian and Atreyu must confront the returning Emptiness before the world disappears entirely.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Transported back to Fantasia, Bastian discovers the world he once saved faces a new threat: the evil sorceress Xayide and a creeping Emptiness, forcing him to join up with Atreyu once more.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Exciting and familiar family fantasy with a steady pace and moderate peril, offering an engaging yet easy-watch quest.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by George T. Miller, this brisk 90-minute fantasy adventure delivers an exciting, nostalgic return to a beloved storybook realm with clear stakes for family viewing.
